subject.title: feat(onboarding): prefer strongest local model in guided detection

question: Should the evolving local-model preference heuristic become a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or remain private to OpenClaw's guided-onboarding/provider implementations?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but repository policy cannot determine whether third-party plugins should inherit and depend on OpenClaw's opinionated model-family ranking.

options.title: Keep policy owner-private
options.body: Rebase and implement the heuristic at the current onboarding/provider owner boundary without adding a public SDK contract unless a generic extension seam is demonstrably required.

options.title: Sponsor the SDK contract
options.body: Keep the public export, explicitly document that ranking semantics may evolve, and add compatibility-focused tests and ownership for external consumers.

options.title: Pause automatic ranking
options.body: Retain stable first/default selection until benchmark ownership, update cadence, and real-runtime behavior are established.

recommendation.title: Keep policy owner-private
recommendation.body: Rebase and implement the heuristic at the current onboarding/provider owner boundary without adding a public SDK contract unless a generic extension seam is demonstrably required.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this person as the proposer of this change and the adjacent local-model onboarding direction.
